week_selection.method: SHA-256(candidate-01-v22-calendar-target-mss-retest:<0..2>) modulo the remaining ordered Monday pool, removing each selected week before the next draw; frozen before execution

execution_data: official Binance Vision aggregate trades as one-for-one TradeTick

frozen_v21_logic.information_clock: daily causal equal-notional target representing one minute of the immediately preceding completed UTC day
frozen_v21_logic.failed_sweep: same-side pivot sweep, close back inside, initiative/reversal flow sign change
frozen_v21_logic.mss: completed event close through nearer opposing pivot with aligned aggressive flow
frozen_v21_logic.entry_confirmation: later completed event retests the broken pivot and closes rejected with aligned aggressive flow
frozen_v21_logic.invalidation: post-MSS retest-path adverse extreme plus unchanged 7-bps buffer

calendar_levels: completed prior UTC-day highs and lows
completed prior UTC Monday-Sunday week highs and lows
new_target_logic.activation: only after the full source day or all seven source week days complete
new_target_logic.consumption: removed on the first later completed equal-notional event whose range trades the level
new_target_logic.selection: nearest active level in the trade direction strictly beyond the farther local opposing pivot, selected at failed-sweep confirmation

second_and_third_week_policy: run unchanged only when the preceding frozen week fully passes
long_evaluation_policy: open only after all three frozen weeks fully pass without logic or parameter changes
